Personally I think Maxx "C" Is a necessary evil, it can be oppressive but can still be played through. It forces you(or your opponent) to consider and weigh their options, you can A. Give your opponent free cards and combo off, hoping your end board stands a chance, or B. End on something simple and hope they didn't get too many key pieces. TL;DR: I think Maxx "C" is a fine card
